changes.previous_summary: The TSUBAME4 operator reports an emergency maintenance procedure on September 7,2026, involving running jobs and successive compute-node restarts. Its 19:00 update says work finished at about 18:40. This is evidence of an existing operational computing service, with maintenance interruptions; it is not a new opening or an uninterrupted-availability guarantee.
changes.public_summary: The TSUBAME4 operator completed emergency compute-node maintenance at about 18:40 on September 7, 2026. The work involved running jobs and successive compute-node restarts.

changes.previous_summary: The operator status board explicitly timestamps TSUBAME4 availability at 10:00 on September 29,2026, and the login nodes, batch queue, storage and application services at 11:00. A separate 11:20 note reports an application-distribution request defect. The containing homepage has no selected publication day; October 15 retrieval does not refresh the timestamp. This later direct observation corroborates operating service.
changes.public_summary: The operator reported TSUBAME4 available at 10:00 on September 29, 2026, followed by login nodes, batch queues, storage and application services at 11:00. A separate 11:20 notice reported a problem with application-distribution requests.

changes.previous_summary: The April 9, 2024 TSUBAME4 guidance identifies the Suzukakedai campus G4-A building as the converted data center. changes.public_summary: The April 2024 TSUBAME4 guide identifies G4-A as the converted data-center building. Its layout shows a 210 m² machine room, separate electrical rooms and outdoor cooling equipment. The room area describes the 2024 layout; it is not the total building area.

changes.previous_summary: Current TSUBAME4 visitor information identifies its location as Yokohama, formerly Suzukakedai, and explicitly distinguishes it from Ookayama. This supports continuity of host-campus identity without treating the undated page as a fresh operational observation.
changes.public_summary: TSUBAME4 visitor information places the facility at Yokohama campus, formerly called Suzukakedai.

changes.public_summary: Science Tokyo’s Yokohama campus map identifies G4-A as building 34, separate from G4, building 33.

changes.public_summary: Suzukakedai was renamed Yokohama Campus on April 1, 2026.

changes.previous_summary: The university’s June 6,2024 report describes TSUBAME4 beginning operation at Suzukakedai and being available to university, external academic and corporate researchers.
